title: Bhikhari Boss
description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

title: Raj Tilak
description: A reincarnated ancient prince is reborn as a 15-year-old lost heir in a powerful modern family, where he faces rejection, rivalry, and betrayal. Armed with mysterious powers and knowledge from his past life, he sets out to reclaim his rightful place and uncover hidden truths.

title: Golden Boy Ki Love Story
description: Yohan, a hidden billionaire, marries Suhana, who is forced to wed to save her inheritance. As love grows, he reveals his true identity and protects her from betrayal and danger. In the end, they overcome all odds and find happiness together.

title: Love In Paris
description: After a whirlwind encounter in Paris and a chance reunion years later, a resilient woman named Kavya enters into a high-stakes contract marriage with Vedant, unaware that her "hired" husband is actually a billionaire CEO.

title: Fake Doctor
description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

title: Too much, Mr husband
description: A mysterious truck driver with a hidden past crosses paths with a runaway bride, leading to a one-night encounter that binds them forever, years later, when she returns with a daughter claiming him as the father, their lives collide again amid dangerous enemies, family conspiracies

title: My Lucky Star
description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

title: King's Killer Comeback
description: Yeh high-voltage revenge drama class divide, fake identity aur betrayal par based hai, jiska core theme hai “Perception vs Reality.” Adhiraj, ek billionaire mafia king, apni identity chhupakar jeeta hai, jabki uski wife Aviva usse dhokha dekar uski power ka misuse karti hai. Shaadi ka setup ego clashes aur hidden truths ka battlefield ban jaata hai, jahan har episode ke saath tension aur stakes badhte hain. yeh story greed, ambition aur ultimate power reveal ko explore karti hai
